blocks.text: Atoqli otlar va the: umumiy mantiq

Atoqli ot (ism, joy nomi) o'zi yagona narsani ko'rsatadi, shuning uchun odatda artiklsiz ishlatiladi: **Aziz**, **Tashkent**, **Uzbekistan**. Asosiy qoidalar qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 73-dars), artiklning umumiy ma'nolari esa 72–76-darslarda. Bu darsda — odam ismlari, unvonlar va geografik nomlar; ko'cha, bino va tashkilot nomlari — keyingi darsda (→ 78-dars). Ko'p holatni bitta mantiq tushuntiradi: nom tarkibida **oddiy ot** (republic, kingdom, islands, sea, valley) bo'lsa yoki nom **ko'plikda** bo'lsa — odatda **the** kerak; nom faqat atoqli so'zdan iborat bo'lsa — the yo'q.

Ism va familiya oldida artikl yo'q: **Madina**, **Oliver Smith**. Ismdan oldingi unvon ham artiklsiz: **Mr** Karimov, **Mrs** Brown, **Dr** Wilson, **Professor** Green, **President** Lincoln, **Queen** Victoria, **Captain** Jones, **Uncle** Rustam, **Saint** Paul. Unvon **ismsiz** kelsa, u oddiy otga aylanadi va **the** oladi: **the** doctor, **the** professor, **the** President, **the** Queen. O'zbekchada ham farq seziladi: «doktor Rashidova» — aniq odamning nomi, «shifokor» — vazifa.

items.text: **Dr Saidova** will see you now, so please go into room five.
items.translation: **Doktor Saidova** sizni hozir qabul qiladi, beshinchi xonaga kiring.

items.text: I need to speak to **the doctor** before I take any more of these pills.
items.translation: Bu dorilardan yana ichishdan oldin **shifokor** bilan gaplashishim kerak.

items.text: **Aunt Kate** is flying in from Edinburgh for my graduation.
items.translation: Bitiruv kechamga **Keyt xola** Edinburgdan uchib keladi.

blocks.text: Familiyaning ko'pligi oldida **the** — butun oila: **the Karimovs** = Karimovlar oilasi, **the Smiths** = Smitlar. Ismga **the** faqat bir xil ismli odamlarni ajratishda qo'shiladi: Do you mean **the** Aziz from accounts? (buxgalteriyadagi Azizni nazarda tutyapsizmi?). Joy nomi bilan ham shunday: ergash gap yoki of-birikma uni «o'sha davrdagi» deb ajratsa — **the**: **the** Tashkent of the 1970s (70-yillardagi Toshkent). Oddiy sifat esa the talab qilmaydi: **modern** Tashkent, **ancient** Samarkand, **Victorian** London.
Mamlakatlar: Uzbekistan, lekin the Czech Republic

Qit'a, mamlakat, shtat, viloyat va shahar — the siz: Asia, Uzbekistan, Texas, Khorezm, London. Lekin davlat nomida **Republic**, **Kingdom**, **States**, **Emirates** kabi oddiy ot bo'lsa — **the**: **the** Czech Republic, **the** United Kingdom (**the** UK), **the** United States (**the** USA), **the** United Arab Emirates, **the** Republic of Karakalpakstan. Bitta davlatning ikki nomi bo'lishi mumkin: **Kyrgyzstan** — **the** Kyrgyz Republic, **South Korea** — **the** Republic of Korea. Ko'plikdagi nomlar ham **the** oladi: **the** Netherlands, **the** Philippines.
Tog'lar va orollar: yakka — the siz, guruh — the bilan

Yakka tog' — the siz: **Everest** (Mount Everest), **Ben Nevis**, **Kilimanjaro**. Tog' tizmasi — **the**: **the** Alps, **the** Himalayas, **the** Andes, **the** Tian Shan, **the** Pamirs. Orollar ham xuddi shunday: yakka orol — **Sicily**, **Cyprus**, **Bali**; orollar guruhi — **the** Canaries, **the** Maldives, **the** Seychelles. Nomda **of** bo'lsa — yana **the**: **the** Isle of Wight, **the** Isle of Man. Mantiq oddiy: tizma va guruh — bir nechta narsa, ya'ni ko'plik.

items.text: We're thinking of going to **Bali** or **the Philippines** for our honeymoon.
items.translation: Asal oyimiz uchun **Bali**ga yoki **Filippinga** borishni o'ylayapmiz.

items.text: **The Andes** run along the whole west coast of South America.
items.translation: **And tog'lari** Janubiy Amerikaning butun g'arbiy sohili bo'ylab cho'zilgan.

items.text: Jasur climbed **Kilimanjaro** last year, and now he dreams of **Everest**.
items.translation: Jasur o'tgan yili **Kilimanjaroga** chiqdi, endi esa **Everest** haqida orzu qiladi.

blocks.text: Suv va cho'l: the Amu Darya, the Kyzylkum — lekin Lake Aydarkul

Okean, dengiz, daryo va kanal nomlari — doim **the**: **the** Atlantic (Ocean), **the** Indian Ocean, **the** Mediterranean (Sea), **the** Black Sea, **the** Aral Sea, **the** Amu Darya, **the** Syr Darya, **the** Zarafshan, **the** Thames (yoki **the** River Thames), **the** Suez Canal, **the** English Channel. Cho'l, vodiy va yassi tog'lik ham odatda **the** bilan: **the** Sahara, **the** Kyzylkum, **the** Fergana Valley, **the** Ustyurt Plateau. Ko'l esa istisno: **Lake** + nom — the siz: **Lake** Aydarkul (yoki shunchaki Aydarkul), **Lake** Baikal, **Lake** Geneva. «Amu Darya» nomining o'zida «daryo» bor, shuning uchun «River» qo'shilmaydi, lekin **the** baribir kerak.

items.text: **The Zarafshan** carries water from the mountains to Samarkand and Bukhara.
items.translation: **Zarafshon** tog'lardan Samarqand va Buxoroga suv olib keladi.

items.text: My grandparents still remember the days when **the Aral Sea** was full of fish.
items.translation: Bobom va buvim **Orol dengizi** baliqqa to'la bo'lgan kunlarni hali ham eslashadi.

items.text: **Lake Geneva** lies on the border between Switzerland and France.
items.translation: **Jeneva ko'li** Shveytsariya va Fransiya chegarasida joylashgan.

blocks.text: Dunyo tomonlari: northern England va the north of England

North, South, East, West, Central nomning bir qismi bo'lsa — the siz: **North America**, **South Korea**, **East Asia**, **Central Asia**. Sifat shakli (**northern**, **southern**, **eastern**, **western**) + nom — ham the siz: **northern** England, **southern** Uzbekistan, **western** Europe. Lekin **the north / the south ... of** + nom — **the** bilan: **the north of** England, **the south of** Uzbekistan, **the west of** the country. Bir nechta tayyor nom ham **the** oladi: **the Middle East**, **the Far East**, **the West** (G'arb mamlakatlari). O'zbekcha «Markaziy Osiyo» va «Yaqin Sharq» bir xil tuzilgan, lekin inglizchada biri the siz, biri the bilan — buni yodlab olish kerak.

items.text: Termez is in **the south of Uzbekistan**, close to the Afghan border.
items.translation: Termiz **O'zbekiston janubida**, Afg'oniston chegarasi yaqinida joylashgan.

items.text: Rents in **southern Europe** are usually lower than in **the north**.
items.translation: **Janubiy Yevropada** ijara haqi odatda **shimoldagidan** pastroq bo'ladi.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «the Doctor Rashidova» → **Doctor Rashidova** (unvon + ism — the siz); «I'll ask doctor» → **I'll ask the doctor**; «She lives in Netherlands» → **She lives in the Netherlands**; «the Lake Aydarkul» → **Lake Aydarkul**; «Aral Sea is shrinking» → **The Aral Sea is shrinking**; «the Central Asia» → **Central Asia**; «in Middle East» → **in the Middle East**; «in north of England» → **in the north of England** (yoki **in northern England**); «the Everest» → **Everest**.

Ikki savol bering. 1) Nomda **oddiy so'z** bormi (republic, kingdom, states, islands, sea, ocean, valley, desert) yoki nom **ko'plikdami**? — Ha bo'lsa, **the**. 2) Bu **suv**mi (daryo, dengiz, okean, kanal)? — **the**, faqat **Lake** bundan mustasno. Qolgan hollarda — ism, shahar, mamlakat, yakka tog' — the yo'q.

Ba'zi nomlarda qo'llanish turlicha yoki an'anaviy: **the** Gambia, **The** Hague (shahar — the bilan, bosh harf bilan yoziladi), **the** Congo; Ukraine va Sudan — hozir odatda the siz (eski matnlarda «the Ukraine» uchraydi). Cho'llarda «Desert» so'zi tushib qolishi mumkin: **the** Kyzylkum = **the** Kyzylkum Desert. Shubhali holatda lug'at yoki ishonchli xaritaga qarang.

examples.title: No **the** with people: **Mr Karimov**, **Dr Wilson**
examples.description: Ism, familiya va ismdan oldingi unvon (Mr, Dr, Professor, Queen, Uncle) — artiklsiz.

sentences.text: **Mr Karimov** is in a meeting, but he can call you back after lunch.
sentences.translation: **Janob Karimov** majlisda, lekin tushlikdan keyin sizga qayta qo'ng'iroq qila oladi.

sentences.text: I've got an appointment with **Doctor Rashidova** at half past ten tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Ertaga soat o'n yarimda **doktor Rashidova** qabuliga yozilganman.

sentences.text: **Professor Green** from Oxford is giving a lecture on climate change this afternoon.
sentences.translation: Oksforddan kelgan **professor Grin** bugun tushdan keyin iqlim o'zgarishi haqida ma'ruza o'qiydi.

sentences.text: When **Queen Victoria** died in 1901, she had been on the throne for 63 years.
sentences.translation: **Qirolicha Viktoriya** 1901-yilda vafot etganida, u 63 yil taxtda o'tirgan edi.

sentences.text: My grandfather still loves telling stories about **Amir Temur** and his campaigns.
sentences.translation: Bobom hali ham **Amir Temur** va uning yurishlari haqida hikoya qilishni yaxshi ko'radi.

sentences.text: Have you met **Uncle Rustam**? He's just come back from a business trip.
sentences.translation: **Rustam amaki** bilan tanishganmisiz? U hozirgina xizmat safaridan qaytdi.

sentences.text: **Captain Jones** announced that the flight would be an hour late because of fog.
sentences.translation: **Kapitan Jons** tuman sababli reys bir soat kechikishini e'lon qildi.

sentences.text: **Dr Emma Wilson**, who works at a hospital in Manchester, has written a book about sleep.
sentences.translation: Manchesterdagi shifoxonada ishlaydigan **doktor Emma Uilson** uyqu haqida kitob yozgan.

sentences.text: Ask **Mrs Brown** about the exam dates, because she's in charge of the timetable.
sentences.translation: Imtihon sanalarini **Braun xonim**dan so'rang, chunki dars jadvali uning zimmasida.

sentences.text: **Ulugbek** built his famous observatory in Samarkand almost six hundred years ago.
sentences.translation: **Ulug'bek** o'zining mashhur rasadxonasini qariyb olti yuz yil oldin Samarqandda qurdirgan.

examples.title: Without a name: **the doctor**, **the Karimovs**
examples.description: Unvon ismsiz kelsa — oddiy ot, **the** bilan. Familiyaning ko'pligi (the Karimovs) — butun oila; bir xil ismli odamni ajratishda ham **the**.

sentences.text: **The doctor** says Grandma can go home on Friday if her blood test is normal.
sentences.translation: **Shifokorning** aytishicha, qon tahlili yaxshi chiqsa, buvim juma kuni uyga ketishi mumkin.

sentences.text: We waited for an hour, but **the professor** never turned up to the seminar.
sentences.translation: Bir soat kutdik, lekin **professor** seminarga kelmadi ham.

sentences.text: **The President** is going to speak on television tonight about the new tax law.
sentences.translation: **Prezident** bugun kechqurun televizorda yangi soliq qonuni haqida nutq so'zlaydi.

sentences.text: Last month **the Karimovs** moved to a bigger flat near Amir Temur Square.
sentences.translation: O'tgan oy **Karimovlar oilasi** Amir Temur xiyoboni yaqinidagi kattaroq kvartiraga ko'chib o'tdi.

sentences.text: Are **the Smiths** coming to the wedding, or are they still in Edinburgh?
sentences.translation: **Smitlar oilasi** to'yga keladimi yoki hali ham Edinburgdami?

sentences.text: Every summer **the Yusupovs** invite all their neighbours to a big plov party.
sentences.translation: Har yozda **Yusupovlar** barcha qo'shnilarini katta palov ziyofatiga chaqirishadi.

sentences.text: In the old story, **the king** has three sons, and the youngest is the cleverest.
sentences.translation: Qadimiy ertakda **podshoning** uchta o'g'li bor, eng kenjasi esa eng aqllisi.

sentences.text: Do you mean **the Aziz** who works in marketing, or the one from IT?
sentences.translation: Marketingda ishlaydigan **Azizni** nazarda tutyapsizmi yoki IT bo'limidagisinimi?

sentences.text: **The manager** wasn't in his office, so I left a note with his assistant.
sentences.translation: **Menejer** kabinetida yo'q edi, shuning uchun yordamchisiga xat qoldirdim.

sentences.text: Our new boss is called **Mr Hughes**, but everyone just calls him **the boss**.
sentences.translation: Yangi rahbarimizning ismi **janob Xyuz**, lekin hamma uni shunchaki **boshliq** deb ataydi.

examples.title: Countries: **Uzbekistan** — **the UK**, **the Netherlands**
examples.description: Ko'pchilik davlat nomlari the siz. Nomda Republic, Kingdom, States, Emirates bo'lsa yoki nom ko'plikda bo'lsa — **the**.

sentences.text: **Uzbekistan** shares borders with five countries, including **Kazakhstan** and **Afghanistan**.
sentences.translation: **O'zbekiston** besh davlat, jumladan **Qozog'iston** va **Afg'oniston** bilan chegaradosh.

sentences.text: My cousin is studying engineering in **the Czech Republic** on a government grant.
sentences.translation: Amakivachcham davlat granti asosida **Chexiyada** muhandislik bo'yicha o'qiyapti.

sentences.text: Many Uzbek workers go to **the UK** every summer to pick fruit on farms.
sentences.translation: Ko'plab o'zbek ishchilari har yozda fermalarda meva terish uchun **Buyuk Britaniyaga** borishadi.

sentences.text: Is Amsterdam the capital of **the Netherlands**, or is it **The Hague**?
sentences.translation: **Niderlandiyaning** poytaxti Amsterdammi yoki **Gaaga**mi?

sentences.text: Flights from Tashkent to **the United Arab Emirates** are usually cheaper in January.
sentences.translation: Toshkentdan **Birlashgan Arab Amirliklariga** reyslar yanvarda odatda arzonroq bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Sarah has lived in **France**, **Japan** and **the United States**, but she still prefers London.
sentences.translation: Sara **Fransiyada**, **Yaponiyada** va **AQShda** yashagan, lekin baribir Londonni afzal ko'radi.

sentences.text: In everyday speech people often say **America** instead of **the United States**.
sentences.translation: Kundalik nutqda odamlar ko'pincha **Qo'shma Shtatlar** o'rniga **Amerika** deyishadi.

sentences.text: **The Philippines** is made up of more than seven thousand islands.
sentences.translation: **Filippin** yetti mingdan ortiq oroldan iborat.

sentences.text: Jasur works in **South Korea**, or, to use its official name, **the Republic of Korea**.
sentences.translation: Jasur **Janubiy Koreyada**, rasmiy nomi bilan aytganda, **Koreya Respublikasida** ishlaydi.

sentences.text: Although **Kyrgyzstan** is officially called **the Kyrgyz Republic**, few people use that name in conversation.
sentences.translation: **Qirg'iziston** rasman **Qirg'iz Respublikasi** deb atalsa-da, suhbatda bu nomni kam odam ishlatadi.

examples.title: Islands, mountains: **Sicily**, **Everest** — **the Alps**
examples.description: Yakka orol va yakka tog' — the siz; orollar guruhi va tog' tizmasi — **the** bilan.

sentences.text: **Sicily** is the largest island in **the Mediterranean**.
sentences.translation: **Sitsiliya** — **O'rta yer dengizidagi** eng katta orol.

sentences.text: We're flying to **the Canary Islands** in March because it's warm there all year.
sentences.translation: Martda **Kanar orollariga** uchyapmiz, chunki u yerda butun yil havo iliq.

sentences.text: Dilnoza and her husband spent their honeymoon in **the Maldives** last spring.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza va eri o'tgan bahorda asal oyini **Maldiv orollarida** o'tkazishdi.

sentences.text: Climbing **Everest** costs a fortune, so most people just trek to the base camp.
sentences.translation: **Everestga** chiqish juda qimmatga tushadi, shuning uchun ko'pchilik faqat tayanch lagergacha piyoda boradi.

sentences.text: **Ben Nevis**, the highest mountain in Britain, is often hidden in cloud.
sentences.translation: Britaniyadagi eng baland tog' — **Ben-Nevis** ko'pincha bulutlar ichida yashirinib turadi.

sentences.text: Every winter Aziz goes skiing in **Chimgan**, less than two hours' drive from Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Aziz har qishda Toshkentdan ikki soatlik yo'l ham bo'lmagan **Chimyonga** chang'i uchgani boradi.

sentences.text: **The Tian Shan** stretches across five countries, from Uzbekistan to China.
sentences.translation: **Tyanshan tog'lari** O'zbekistondan Xitoygacha besh davlat hududiga cho'zilgan.

sentences.text: Have you ever been hiking in **the Alps**, or do you prefer lying on a beach?
sentences.translation: Hech **Alp tog'larida** piyoda sayr qilganmisiz yoki plyajda yotishni afzal ko'rasizmi?

sentences.text: Our guide grew up in a tiny village high up in **the Pamirs**.
sentences.translation: Gidimiz **Pomir tog'laridagi** baland bir kichkina qishloqda o'sgan.

sentences.text: Unlike **the Himalayas**, which are a huge range, **Kilimanjaro** is a single mountain standing on its own.
sentences.translation: Ulkan tog' tizmasi bo'lgan **Himolay tog'laridan** farqli o'laroq, **Kilimanjaro** — alohida turgan yakka tog'.

examples.title: Water and deserts: **the Amu Darya**, **the Kyzylkum**
examples.description: Daryo, dengiz, okean, kanal, cho'l va vodiy — **the** bilan. Ko'l esa istisno: **Lake** Aydarkul — the siz.

sentences.text: **The Amu Darya** and **the Syr Darya** both used to flow into **the Aral Sea**.
sentences.translation: **Amudaryo** ham, **Sirdaryo** ham ilgari **Orol dengiziga** quyilardi.

sentences.text: In the 1960s **the Aral Sea** began to shrink because too much water was taken for cotton.
sentences.translation: 1960-yillarda paxta uchun haddan tashqari ko'p suv olingani sababli **Orol dengizi** qisqara boshladi.

sentences.text: We camped in yurts near **Lake Aydarkul** and went swimming every morning.
sentences.translation: **Aydarko'l** yaqinidagi o'tovlarda tunadik va har tong suzishga bordik.

sentences.text: **The Kyzylkum** is one of the largest deserts in Central Asia.
sentences.translation: **Qizilqum** — Markaziy Osiyodagi eng katta cho'llardan biri.

sentences.text: Margilan, which is famous for its silk, is in **the Fergana Valley**.
sentences.translation: Ipagi bilan mashhur Marg'ilon **Farg'ona vodiysida** joylashgan.

sentences.text: Ships travelling between Asia and Europe usually go through **the Suez Canal**.
sentences.translation: Osiyo va Yevropa o'rtasida qatnaydigan kemalar odatda **Suvaysh kanali** orqali o'tadi.

sentences.text: Oliver rowed across **the Atlantic** alone, and it took him almost two months.
sentences.translation: Oliver **Atlantika okeanini** yolg'iz o'zi eshkakli qayiqda kesib o'tdi, bunga qariyb ikki oy ketdi.

sentences.text: Is **the Thames** longer than **the Severn**? — No, **the Severn** is the longest river in Britain.
sentences.translation: **Temza** **Severndan** uzunmi? — Yo'q, Britaniyadagi eng uzun daryo — **Severn**.

sentences.text: Geographers usually describe **the Caspian Sea** as a lake, even though it has «sea» in its name.
sentences.translation: Geograflar **Kaspiy dengizini** odatda ko'l deb ta'riflashadi, garchi nomida «dengiz» so'zi bo'lsa ham.

sentences.text: Although **Lake Baikal** is much deeper, **the Caspian** is far bigger in area.
sentences.translation: **Baykal ko'li** ancha chuqurroq bo'lsa-da, maydoni bo'yicha **Kaspiy** undan ancha katta.

examples.title: **northern England** or **the north of England**?
examples.description: Sifat (northern, southern) + nom va nom tarkibidagi North / Central — the siz; **the north of** ..., **the Middle East**, **the West** — the bilan.

sentences.text: Bekzod's company has opened a new office in **the north of England**, near Leeds.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning kompaniyasi **Angliya shimolida**, Lids yaqinida yangi ofis ochdi.

sentences.text: The weather in **northern England** is usually colder and wetter than in London.
sentences.translation: **Shimoliy Angliyada** ob-havo odatda Londondagidan sovuqroq va namroq bo'ladi.

sentences.text: Khiva is in **the west of Uzbekistan**, roughly a thousand kilometres from Tashkent by road.
sentences.translation: Xiva **O'zbekistonning g'arbida**, Toshkentdan avtomobil yo'li bo'yicha mingga yaqin kilometr narida joylashgan.

sentences.text: In **southern Uzbekistan** summer temperatures often climb above forty degrees.
sentences.translation: **Janubiy O'zbekistonda** yozda harorat ko'pincha qirq darajadan oshib ketadi.

sentences.text: **Central Asia** has no access to the open sea, which makes trade more expensive.
sentences.translation: **Markaziy Osiyo** ochiq dengizga chiqa olmaydi, bu esa savdoni qimmatlashtiradi.

sentences.text: Many people from Fergana work in **the Middle East**, especially in Dubai.
sentences.translation: Ko'plab farg'onaliklar **Yaqin Sharqda**, ayniqsa Dubayda ishlashadi.

sentences.text: **South Korea** and **North Korea** were a single country until the 1940s.
sentences.translation: **Janubiy Koreya** va **Shimoliy Koreya** 1940-yillargacha yagona davlat edi.

sentences.text: Emma grew up in **the south-west of England**, so she's always loved the sea.
sentences.translation: Emma **Angliyaning janubi-g'arbida** o'sgan, shuning uchun dengizni doim yaxshi ko'rgan.

sentences.text: Prices in **the West** are higher, but so are salaries.
sentences.translation: **G'arb mamlakatlarida** narxlar balandroq, lekin maoshlar ham shunday.

sentences.text: Our company's new route connects **East Asia** with **southern Europe** by rail through Uzbekistan.
sentences.translation: Kompaniyamizning yangi yo'nalishi **Sharqiy Osiyoni** O'zbekiston orqali temir yo'l bilan **Janubiy Yevropaga** bog'laydi.

examples.title: Dialogue: a geography quiz night
examples.description: Do'stlar viktorinada geografiya savollariga javob berishadi: the bilan va the siz nomlar aralash.

sentences.text: — Question five: which sea in **Central Asia** has lost most of its water?
sentences.translation: — Beshinchi savol: **Markaziy Osiyodagi** qaysi dengiz suvining katta qismini yo'qotgan?

sentences.text: — That's easy, it's **the Aral Sea**. Write it down, Tom.
sentences.translation: — Oson-ku, bu **Orol dengizi**. Yozib qo'y, Tom.

sentences.text: — Okay. Question six: what's the capital of **the Netherlands**?
sentences.translation: — Xo'p. Oltinchi savol: **Niderlandiyaning** poytaxti qaysi?

sentences.text: — Careful, it's Amsterdam, even though the government sits in **The Hague**.
sentences.translation: — Ehtiyot bo'l, Amsterdam, garchi hukumat **Gaagada** joylashgan bo'lsa ham.

sentences.text: — Next: **Mont Blanc** is the highest peak in which mountain range?
sentences.translation: — Keyingisi: **Monblan** qaysi tog' tizmasining eng baland cho'qqisi?

sentences.text: — That's **the Alps**, of course. I went skiing there last winter.
sentences.translation: — Albatta, **Alp tog'lari**. O'tgan qish o'sha yerda chang'i uchganman.

sentences.text: — Lucky you! Question eight: which is bigger, **Kazakhstan** or **the UK**?
sentences.translation: — Omading bor ekan! Sakkizinchi savol: qaysi biri kattaroq — **Qozog'istonmi** yoki **Buyuk Britaniyami**?

sentences.text: — **Kazakhstan**, easily — it's more than ten times bigger.
sentences.translation: — **Qozog'iston**, shubhasiz — u o'n baravardan ham katta.

sentences.text: — Last one: which islands belong to Spain, **the Canaries** or **the Maldives**?
sentences.translation: — Oxirgisi: qaysi orollar Ispaniyaga tegishli — **Kanar orollarimi** yoki **Maldivmi**?

sentences.text: — **The Canaries**! I think we might actually win tonight.
sentences.translation: — **Kanar orollari**! Menimcha, bugun rostdan ham yutishimiz mumkin.

examples.title: Mixed: news, travel and people
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: odamlar, davlatlar, suv, tog'lar va dunyo tomonlari — murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: Heavy rain has caused flooding in **the south of France** and parts of **northern Italy**.
sentences.translation: Kuchli yomg'ir **Fransiya janubida** va **Shimoliy Italiyaning** ayrim qismlarida suv toshqiniga sabab bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Scientists from **the United States** and **Uzbekistan** are working together to save the area around **the Aral Sea**.
sentences.translation: **AQSh** va **O'zbekiston** olimlari **Orol dengizi** atrofidagi hududni qutqarish uchun birgalikda ishlamoqda.

sentences.text: **Professor Rashidov** has spent twenty years studying the glaciers of **the Pamirs**.
sentences.translation: **Professor Rashidov** yigirma yildan beri **Pomir** muzliklarini o'rganib keladi.

sentences.text: Cheap flights to **Sri Lanka** and **the Seychelles** are becoming more and more popular.
sentences.translation: **Shri-Lanka** va **Seyshel orollariga** arzon reyslar tobora ommalashib bormoqda.

sentences.text: The new railway will link **the Fergana Valley** with **the Kyrgyz Republic** and **China**.
sentences.translation: Yangi temir yo'l **Farg'ona vodiysini** **Qirg'iz Respublikasi** va **Xitoy** bilan bog'laydi.

sentences.text: After crossing **the Kyzylkum** by train, we finally reached **Nukus**, the capital of **the Republic of Karakalpakstan**.
sentences.translation: Poyezdda **Qizilqumni** kesib o'tib, nihoyat **Qoraqalpog'iston Respublikasining** poytaxti **Nukusga** yetib keldik.

sentences.text: James is moving from London to **the Isle of Wight**, where houses are cheaper.
sentences.translation: Jeyms Londondan uylar arzonroq bo'lgan **Uayt oroliga** ko'chib o'tyapti.

sentences.text: **The Netherlands** have never won the World Cup, although they've played in three finals.
sentences.translation: **Niderlandiya** terma jamoasi jahon chempionatida hech qachon g'olib bo'lmagan, garchi uch marta finalda o'ynagan bo'lsa ham.

sentences.text: Do **the Taylors** still live in **southern Spain**, or have they moved back to **Manchester**?
sentences.translation: **Teylorlar oilasi** hali ham **Ispaniya janubida** yashaydimi yoki **Manchesterga** qaytib ko'chib kelishdimi?

sentences.text: **Mount Everest** stands on the border between **Nepal** and **China**, in the middle of **the Himalayas**.
sentences.translation: **Everest tog'i** **Himolay tog'larining** o'rtasida, **Nepal** va **Xitoy** chegarasida joylashgan.
